releaseNotes: Discord Rich Presence now shows 'Listening to Sonora' with a live progress bar — indistinguishable from Spotify's integration (was incorrectly showing 'Playing')
Mobile build fixes — Google sign-in now works on the Android app (WebView user-agent corrected), and the app installs with the real Sonora icon
Android app reliability — the full Sonora experience loads consistently in the native WebView
Premium rich embeds — share any song or playlist to Discord, X, WhatsApp and more with real artwork + metadata
Upgraded Share sheet with live preview, Discord, QR code and social intents
Shared links open the exact song or playlist, even after signing in
Multi-artist Smart Playlist — search and blend any number of artists into one taste-ranked playlist
Artist Mixes for every artist — Spotify-style mixes generated on demand for any artist, not just your favorites
Mixes filter in Search — type an artist name and get their mix plus similar-artist mixes instantly
Pages auto-load with zero flash — cross-mount caching means no more skeleton stutter when navigating back
Search results appear instantly on cache hits — no debounce delay when returning to a previous query
Discord Rich Presence shows 'Listening to Sonora' with a live progress bar, album art, and dual buttons
